people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
translations.bsb: Then Moses presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translations.kjv: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
translations.asv: And he presented the ram of the burnt-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
